job.title: Security Engineer, Incident Response
job.pay_full: $140,400 – $166,100 a year base salary (New York City headquarters), plus annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan

details.about: Peloton is a connected fitness company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, that combines hardware, software and exclusive content for millions of members in the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia and Austria. Its security operations team has no traditional SOC tier structure: this engineer improves and creates detections, builds automations and helps define the solutions roadmap so security scales with the business.
duties: Research and analyse intelligence data from many sources to drive threat hunting
Track vulnerabilities, threat actors, indicators of compromise, tactics, techniques and procedures, and trends
Use intel-driven insights to search the Peloton enterprise for anomalous or malicious activity
Work with Security Engineering and the Security Operations Center to baseline behaviour and build new detections and response workflows
Support triage for incident response and investigations
Recommend and build countermeasures based on threat analysis, intelligence and forecasting
Develop and maintain security incident playbooks and runbooks
Present findings and recommendations to managers, team leads and senior leadership in briefings, reports and dashboards
Remove repetitive, high-volume SOC workflows through AI-powered triage pipelines, LLM-assisted investigation and end-to-end automation
Design and ship in-house security tooling where commercial products fall short
Turn threat intelligence and incident learnings into prioritised control recommendations
needs: At least 5 years in information security
Experience in incident response or threat detection; in-depth knowledge of cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes), SaaS platforms (O365, Google Workspace) or IAM is valued
Strong knowledge of incident response principles and processes
Experience automating alert intake, triage and incident handling
Expert experience with SIEM tools or data lakes
Experience dissecting attacker methodologies and techniques and/or with EDR tooling
Comfortable using AI coding tools as a primary development accelerator
A learning mindset and excitement for new technologies and security areas
nice: Relevant certifications: GCIH, GCFE, GCIA, GCFA, AWS Security Specialty
details.benefits: Base salary $140,400 – $166,100 a year for this role at the New York City headquarters; the actual offer depends on experience, business objectives and location. Total rewards also include annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, a generous paid time off policy, short- and long-term disability, access to mental health services, a 401(k), tuition reimbursement and student loan paydown plans, fertility and adoption support, up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave, child care and family care discounts, free access to the Peloton Digital App with apparel and product discounts, commuter benefits with a Citi Bike discount, and pet insurance.
notes: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States full time; the role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including H-1B transfers
Peloton does not permit the use of AI tools at any stage of its application and interview process
Peloton never charges application, processing or training fees; genuine recruiting emails come from an @onepeloton.com address
Accommodations from application through interview can be requested at applicantaccommodations@onepeloton.com
